title: senecio pinnatifolius var. maritimus
intro: Senecio pinnatifolius var. maritimus, commonly known as Irish sea ragwort, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to the coastlines of Ireland and the United Kingdom. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help in the treatment of various conditions including wounds, infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Irish sea ragwort include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve digestive issues, and act as an expectorant to help relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
